Colin Demarest / Axios :

 New England-based autonomous submarine startup Corridian emerges from stealth with a $38M seed led by Point72 Ventures and plans to unveil its first AUV in 2027   —  Corridian, a New England-based robo-submarine maker, exited stealth Tuesday morning alongside word of its $38 million seed.
